text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا۟ مِنْ حَيْثُ أَمَرَهُمْ أَبُوهُم مَّا كَانَ يُغْنِى عَنْهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا حَاجَةًۭ فِى نَفْسِ يَعْقُوبَ قَضَىٰهَا ۚ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذُو عِلْمٍۢ لِّمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

words.gloss_range: compressed opening conjunction linking fulfillment of the previous instruction to the new narrated scene
words.prose: The opening particle ties this ayah directly to the prior command, so the entry scene is heard as narrated compliance rather than a fresh, isolated start. Its one-letter form compresses the cross-ayah hinge into the first token.

topics.headline: cross-ayah narrative resumption
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens as the execution of the previous instruction, not as a detached scene.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the ayah opens as the execution of the previous instruction, not as a detached scene.

words.gloss_range: temporal-conditional when-frame governing the completed entry before the evaluation of non-availing
words.prose: The temporal particle frames the completed entry as the occasion for the narrator's evaluation. It means when in this setting, because it governs the perfect verb that follows; treating it as not-yet would break the action-to-assessment sequence.

topics.headline: temporal frame before evaluation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brothers' entry triggers a theological assessment rather than merely continuing the story chronologically.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the brothers' entry triggers a theological assessment rather than merely continuing the story chronologically.

words.gloss_range: completed plural entry into the instructed places; concrete movement plus same-surah entry motif (12:67, 12:68, 12:69, 12:88, 12:99), with broad destination patterns only secondary
words.root_gloss_range: entering, admission, and movement into a space; here concrete completed entry into the instructed routes, with wider entry motifs only as contextual echo
words.prose: The perfect plural reports the brothers' compliance as already accomplished. The verb keeps concrete movement into place at the scene boundary, while same-surah entry scenes make this action part of a larger sequence from instruction and crisis toward later reunion (12:67, 12:68, 12:69, 12:88, 12:99).

topics.headline: completed collective entry and entry motif
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that obedience is granted as a completed act within the surah's entry sequence (12:67, 12:68, 12:69, 12:88, 12:99) before the verse denies that obedience any independent protective power.
topics.reason: The reader notices that obedience is granted as a completed act within the surah's entry sequence (12:67, 12:68, 12:69, 12:88, 12:99) before the verse denies that obedience any independent protective power.

words.gloss_range: route/source preposition marking entry from specified points and beginning a three-min progression
words.prose: This preposition makes the entry a route-governed act, from where Jacob had commanded, rather than a generic arrival. It also begins the ayah's repeated min-sequence, which later shifts from route to divine source to total negation.

topics.headline: specified route and min-sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how a small preposition preserves the practical gate strategy before the same particle family is used for theological limit.
topics.reason: The reader notices how a small preposition preserves the practical gate strategy before the same particle family is used for theological limit.

words.gloss_range: locative adverb of place governed by min and filled by the prior gate instruction
words.prose: The locative adverb points to the concrete places of entry and is expanded by the following command clause. The reported vowel variant does not change the mechanism; the phrase still depends on the gate instruction in 12:67.

topics.headline: locative compliance with prior instruction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brothers obey the form of Jacob's route instruction to the letter, even though the next clause denies its protective efficacy.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the brothers obey the form of Jacob's route instruction to the letter, even though the next clause denies its protective efficacy.

words.gloss_range: completed authoritative command with the brothers encoded as object and content supplied by 12:67
words.root_gloss_range: command, order, affair, and authority; here a completed paternal command whose content is supplied by the prior ayah
words.prose: The verb recasts Jacob's earlier imperatives as a completed command whose object is the brothers. Because the named subject follows the verb and suffix, the reader first hears the command's effect on them and only then the father who issued it.

topics.headline: completed paternal command and cross-ayah complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human command is honored as real obedience while being placed beside divine limit and later fulfillment.
topics.reason: The reader notices that human command is honored as real obedience while being placed beside divine limit and later fulfillment.

words.gloss_range: their father as nominative commanding agent, compactly joining kinship and authority
words.root_gloss_range: fatherhood and paternal relation; here the five-noun form marks the father as commanding agent, with root derivation kept cautious
words.prose: The five-noun form marks their father as the agent of the command. The delayed placement honors paternal authority but also positions it just before the clause that bounds what that authority can accomplish.

topics.headline: father as delayed commanding agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the move from obeyed paternal authority to the immediate theological limit on that authority.
topics.reason: The reader notices the move from obeyed paternal authority to the immediate theological limit on that authority.

words.gloss_range: negator scoping over the whole past-capacity non-avail construction
words.prose: The negator cancels the whole availing construction before any exception is introduced. This makes the verse deny outward efficacy first, then separately preserve Jacob's inward need.

topics.headline: whole-clause negation of efficacy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the strategy is measured as powerless before the text allows a narrower inner motive to remain.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the strategy is measured as powerless before the text allows a narrower inner motive to remain.

words.gloss_range: auxiliary past-state frame denying capacity or ongoing availing in that situation
words.root_gloss_range: being, occurrence, and auxiliary aspect; here the root is grammaticalized in a negated capacity construction
words.prose: The auxiliary turns the clause into a past-capacity assessment: the plan was not in a position to avail. The construction is stronger than a simple event report, because it judges the measure's capacity under the narrated circumstances.

topics.headline: past-capacity non-avail frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the narrator confirms Jacob's warning as a settled assessment of capacity, not merely a failed incident.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the narrator confirms Jacob's warning as a settled assessment of capacity, not merely a failed incident.

words.gloss_range: Form IV availing or sufficing under negation; no strategy creates protection against divine decree
words.root_gloss_range: sufficiency, independence, enriching, and availing; here Form IV under negation means no protective availing before God, not material wealth
words.prose: The imperfect in the auxiliary construction denies any ongoing or potential availing. The root's sufficiency pressure sharpens the point: Jacob's measure could not make the brothers independent of God or interpose protection from His decree.

topics.headline: negated availing and sufficiency before God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the failure is theological sufficiency, not tactical usefulness or material wealth.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the failure is theological sufficiency, not tactical usefulness or material wealth.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus pronoun marking the brothers as the protected parties from whom harm would be turned away
words.prose: The fused preposition and pronoun make the brothers the affected group inside the non-avail formula. The wording denies that the plan could turn divine decree away from them or act protectively on their behalf.

topics.headline: brothers as beneficiaries of denied availing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied protection is directed toward the brothers specifically, not toward an abstract plan.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the denied protection is directed toward the brothers specifically, not toward an abstract plan.

words.gloss_range: divine-side source preposition in the non-avail formula
words.prose: This preposition places God as the reference point from whose side no availing is possible. It shifts the clause away from human skill and toward divine determination before the final exhaustive negation arrives.

topics.headline: divine-side limit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the boundary on precaution is located at the divine side, not merely in practical weakness.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the boundary on precaution is located at the divine side, not merely in practical weakness.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as the central referent in the non-avail formula, not a derivational argument
words.root_gloss_range: divine-name field with debated derivation; here the proper name functions as the fixed divine referent in the non-avail formula
words.prose: The divine name is syntactically governed inside the non-avail formula, so the line is theocentric rather than merely practical. Its force comes from God as the named referent of the limit, within a nearby divine-name cluster (12:66, 12:67, 12:68, 12:73, 12:76); derivational claims about the name are secondary to that proper-name function.

topics.headline: proper-name and derivation limit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the theological force rests on the proper divine name in syntax, not on speculative etymology.
topics.reason: The local evidence treats the token as a proper divine name, so derivational claims must remain secondary.

topics.headline: divine axis of non-availing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that God is the named axis between human precaution and exhaustive negation, in continuity with the nearby divine-name cluster (12:66, 12:67, 12:68, 12:73, 12:76).
topics.reason: The reader notices that God is the named axis between human precaution and exhaustive negation, in continuity with the nearby divine-name cluster (12:66, 12:67, 12:68, 12:73, 12:76).

words.gloss_range: partitive or extra min after negation, intensifying the denial to not anything at all
words.prose: After negation, this particle totalizes the denial with the following indefinite. It completes the ayah's triple-min movement: route, divine side, then not even a single thing of protective effect.

topics.headline: partitive min for exhaustive negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar excludes even minimal protective efficacy, not just major success.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the grammar excludes even minimal protective efficacy, not just major success.

words.gloss_range: indefinite thing under negation, the minimal unit that makes the non-avail denial exhaustive
words.root_gloss_range: thinghood, entity, and any minimal item; here the indefinite under negation supports exhaustive denial
words.prose: The indefinite noun closes the non-avail formula by denying even one thing of benefit. Its breadth is immediately checked by the exception, so the verse can say no outward efficacy remained while one inward concern was still fulfilled.

topics.headline: minimal-unit exhaustive denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the difference between no protective thing at all and the later narrow exception of an inward need.
topics.reason: The reader notices the difference between no protective thing at all and the later narrow exception of an inward need.

words.gloss_range: exception particle pivoting from total non-avail to a disconnected inward exception
words.prose: The exception particle does not undo the denial of protection. It pivots to a likely disconnected exception: not a thing availed against God, but a need inside Jacob was fulfilled.

topics.headline: disconnected exception after total negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exception preserves psychological fulfillment without turning the tactic into protection.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the exception preserves psychological fulfillment without turning the tactic into protection.

words.gloss_range: one bounded inner need or concern, not ritual pilgrimage or a dispute branch
words.root_gloss_range: argument, proof, pilgrimage, and debated connection to need; here the surface noun selects need or concern, not ritual or dispute
words.prose: The noun names the narrow item allowed after the total denial: a need or concern. Its accusative exception role and the following inner-location phrase keep it psychological and bounded, and the need is then immediately settled by the verb at word 21; root-table links to pilgrimage or argument are not the local sense.

topics.headline: bounded inward need after exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Jacob's plan served an inward need that is named and then settled, rather than producing outward safety.
topics.reason: The reader notices that Jacob's plan served an inward need that is named and then settled, rather than producing outward safety.

words.gloss_range: in-location preposition turning Jacob's self into the container of the need
words.prose: This preposition internalizes the exception. It makes the need reside inside Jacob's self, so the verse moves from abstract concern to embodied interior motive.

topics.headline: spatial grammar of interiority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exception is located inwardly, not in the brothers' external safety.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the exception is located inwardly, not in the brothers' external safety.

words.gloss_range: Jacob's own inner self or soul as the construct location of the need
words.root_gloss_range: self, soul, breath, inner life, and appetite; here the construct phrase locates Jacob’s need in his own inner self
words.prose: The construct phrase binds the inner self directly to Jacob. The word carries self, soul, and life-pressure resonances, but the local grammar keeps the point specific: this was his own interior need, not a general human feeling or outward cause. It also places Jacob's concern within Surah Yusuf's recurring interior-life vocabulary (12:18, 12:23, 12:51, 12:77, 12:83).

topics.headline: Jacob's owned inner self
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the personal interiority of Jacob's concern, set within the surah's recurring interior-life vocabulary (12:18, 12:23, 12:51, 12:77, 12:83), not merely a strategic motive.
topics.reason: The reader notices the personal interiority of Jacob's concern, set within the surah's recurring interior-life vocabulary (12:18, 12:23, 12:51, 12:77, 12:83), not merely a strategic motive.

words.gloss_range: foreign proper name specifying the bearer of the inner need and later recipient of divine teaching
words.prose: The proper name specifies whose inner self carried the need. It also bridges the earlier kinship title and the following divine-teaching clause by making the named Jacob the same figure who commanded, carried the inward need, and receives the later object pronoun in the teaching clause; Arabic etymology of the foreign name cannot control the local reading.

topics.headline: named bearer and referent bridge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from their father as social role to Jacob as the named prophet whose need and knowledge are being interpreted.
topics.reason: The reader notices the shift from their father as social role to Jacob as the named prophet whose need and knowledge are being interpreted.

topics.headline: Arabic etymology of foreign proper name
topics.blocking_evidence: QAC marks the word as a foreign proper name with no local root, so Arabic root co-occurrence cannot govern the local reading.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a foreign proper name with no local root, so Arabic root co-occurrence cannot govern the local reading.

words.gloss_range: perfect verb settling or fulfilling the feminine need, with decree resonance bounded by the local object
words.root_gloss_range: settling, completing, deciding, judging, and decreeing; here the need is fulfilled or settled with decree resonance kept bounded
words.prose: The perfect verb closes the exception by settling the need named before it. The feminine suffix binds the action back to that need, while the root's decree and decision resonance lets the inward fulfillment sound weighty; compared with the settled-decree wording at 12:41, this local completion remains bounded and does not make the plan protective.

topics.headline: settled need with bounded decree resonance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the only thing completed was Jacob's inner concern, with decree-and-settlement resonance sharpened by 12:41, not independent protection from God.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the only thing completed was Jacob's inner concern, with decree-and-settlement resonance sharpened by 12:41, not independent protection from God.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction moving from fulfilled need into evaluation of Jacob's knowledge
words.prose: This conjunction resumes after the exception and opens the knowledge assessment. It keeps the fulfilled need connected to Jacob's status, so the verse does not leave his action as anxiety alone.

topics.headline: transition to knowledge evaluation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Jacob's inward motive is immediately interpreted through knowledge.
topics.reason: The reader notices that Jacob's inward motive is immediately interpreted through knowledge.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle plus pronoun introducing Jacob as the subject of a confirmed knowledge claim
words.prose: The fused particle and pronoun shift from the narrated Jacob to an emphatically evaluated Jacob. The scope covers the whole knowledge claim, preparing the later contrast with most people.

topics.headline: emphatic confirmation of Jacob's knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse strongly asserts Jacob's knowledge after limiting his precaution.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the verse strongly asserts Jacob's knowledge after limiting his precaution.

words.gloss_range: emphatic lam attached to the predicate, doubling the force of the knowledge assertion
words.prose: This is an emphatic lam, not a preposition. Attached to the predicate, it doubles the force of the preceding emphasis and marks Jacob's knowledge as a major interpretive pivot.

topics.headline: predicate emphasis in the knowledge claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the text insists on Jacob's knowledge precisely after saying his tactic did not avail.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the text insists on Jacob's knowledge precisely after saying his tactic did not avail.

words.gloss_range: possessor-of construction making knowledge a held quality or endowment
words.root_gloss_range: possession and having in construct forms; here it marks Jacob as possessor of knowledge rather than merely performing knowing
words.prose: The construct noun makes Jacob a possessor of knowledge rather than simply someone who knows in the moment. The following phrase will ground that possession in divine teaching, so the status is endowed rather than autonomous expertise, and the wording anticipates the surah's knowledge-ranking statement at 12:76.

topics.headline: possessor construction for endowed knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Jacob is characterized by a held quality of knowledge within the surah's knowledge hierarchy (12:76), not by a successful precaution or a passing act of knowing.
topics.reason: The reader notices that Jacob is characterized by a held quality of knowledge within the surah's knowledge hierarchy (12:76), not by a successful precaution or a passing act of knowing.

words.gloss_range: possessed knowledge or discernment, divinely taught and contrasted with public non-knowledge
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge, knowing, teaching, signs, and discernment; here the local chain selects endowed knowledge, divine teaching, and denied public knowing
words.prose: The verbal noun is the quality Jacob possesses in the emphatic clause. It is knowledge and discernment, not merely a visible mark, and the same root forms a three-part sequence in this ayah: possessed knowledge as a noun, divine teaching as a causative perfect verb, and the final negated imperfect for what most people do not know.

topics.headline: possessed knowledge in the ayah's knowledge chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices knowledge distributed across the ayah in three forms: possessed by Jacob, taught by God, and absent from most people.
topics.reason: The reader notices knowledge distributed across the ayah in three forms: possessed by Jacob, taught by God, and absent from most people.

words.gloss_range: compact causal or content connector linking Jacob's knowledge to what God taught him
words.prose: The fused connector can explain Jacob's knowledge as because of what God taught him and as knowledge concerning that teaching. The reported min-plus-relative variant highlights a real source or partitive contrast, but the local wording keeps causation and content tightly compressed.

topics.headline: divine teaching as ground and content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Jacob's knowledge is derived from divine teaching rather than innate or merely tactical.
topics.reason: The reader notices that Jacob's knowledge is derived from divine teaching rather than innate or merely tactical.

words.gloss_range: Form II perfect divine teaching, with God as teacher and Jacob as recipient encoded in one form
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge, knowing, teaching, signs, and discernment; here the local chain selects endowed knowledge, divine teaching, and denied public knowing
words.prose: The Form II verb names the act that grounds Jacob's knowledge: God taught him. Its first-person plural divine voice and object suffix encode divine teacher and human recipient in one compact form, turning prudence into received knowledge rather than self-generated insight.

topics.headline: divine teaching as warrant for knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the knowledge's provenance: it comes from divine teaching, not from Jacob's autonomous calculation.
topics.reason: The reader notices the knowledge's provenance: it comes from divine teaching, not from Jacob's autonomous calculation.

words.gloss_range: conjunction linking the positive knowledge claim to the adversative public-ignorance clause
words.prose: The conjunction carries the knowledge assertion forward into the adversative close. It makes the final ignorance clause a connected qualification of the knowledge claim, not a detached moral comment.

topics.headline: link into final contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that public ignorance is coordinated with, and set against, Jacob's taught knowledge.
topics.reason: The reader notices that public ignorance is coordinated with, and set against, Jacob's taught knowledge.

words.gloss_range: adversative particle governing the closing contrast between one taught knower and most people
words.prose: The adversative particle starts the final counterweight: Jacob is affirmed as taught and knowing, but most people do not know. Its grammar makes the contrast explicit rather than optional.

topics.headline: adversative contrast with public ignorance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's final turn from one endowed knower to the majority who lack that knowledge.
topics.reason: The reader notices the ayah's final turn from one endowed knower to the majority who lack that knowledge.

words.gloss_range: elative construct meaning most of the people, carrying evaluative majority pressure
words.root_gloss_range: manyness, increase, abundance, and majority; here the elative construct means most of the people, not mere abundance
words.prose: The elative construct means most of the people, not merely abundant people. In a negated knowledge clause, the majority term undercuts numerical authority: mass consensus is not the same as understanding. It also makes the close join the recurrent most-people-do-not-know formula (12:21, 12:40, 12:68), with a gratitude variant nearby (12:38).

topics.headline: majority as formulaic public-ignorance subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing critique targets the prevailing human condition through a recurrent most-people-do-not-know formula (12:21, 12:40, 12:68), not a small local group.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the closing critique targets the prevailing human condition through a recurrent most-people-do-not-know formula (12:21, 12:40, 12:68), not a small local group.

words.gloss_range: definite collective people or humanity as the genitive complement of most
words.root_gloss_range: people, humanity, sociability, and familiarity with debated derivation; here the surface collective names people as a broad class
words.prose: The definite collective completes the majority phrase as most of the people. Its force is broad and anthropological, setting the mass of humanity against one prophet's endowed knowledge; root speculation about sociability may remain a faint irony, but the local claim rests on the surface collective meaning. The people-language also participates in same-surah public-understanding scenes (12:46, 12:49, 12:68).

topics.headline: people as broad class in majority phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the contrast generalizes from Jacob's family scene to a broad human class, setting the mass of humanity against one prophet's endowed knowledge.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the contrast generalizes from Jacob's family scene to a broad human class, setting the mass of humanity against one prophet's endowed knowledge.

words.gloss_range: negator of the following imperfect, making lack of knowledge the final predicate
words.prose: The negator sets up the final verbal landing. It marks the majority's state as lack of knowledge, so the ayah closes not with the brothers' movement but with a judgment about understanding.

topics.headline: negated knowing as final landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse's last contrast is epistemic deficiency, not mere missing information.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the verse's last contrast is epistemic deficiency, not mere missing information.

words.gloss_range: imperfect plural knowing under negation, characteristic non-understanding contrasted with Jacob's taught knowledge
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge, knowing, teaching, signs, and discernment; here the local chain selects endowed knowledge, divine teaching, and denied public knowing
words.prose: The final verb presents the majority's not-knowing as ongoing or characteristic, not a single past failure. It completes the three-form knowledge chain: Jacob's possessed knowledge, God's act of teaching, and the people's continuing lack of understanding.

topics.headline: ongoing public non-knowledge and root-chain close
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends with an enduring contrast between divinely taught knowledge and ordinary human non-understanding, carried by the final negated imperfect.
topics.reason: The reader notices that the ayah ends with an enduring contrast between divinely taught knowledge and ordinary human non-understanding, carried by the final negated imperfect.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The entry according to the father's command is followed by negated availing, then by the narrow exception of an inward need that was completed.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse grants the commanded act procedural reality and a limited accomplishment while blocking the inference that an enacted means can control what comes from God.

activation_trace.role: Concrete entry supplies the enacted means whose causal reach is being bounded.
An obligating request supplies the paternal procedure that the sons actually follow.
Sufficiency or standing in for another supplies the efficacy explicitly denied to the procedure.
Need supplies the restricted object that the act can genuinely meet.
Finishing and bringing to completion closes the need without enlarging it into external control.

changed_reading.before: The father's instruction is a precaution whose value depends on preventing harm.
changed_reading.after: The instruction can be validly obeyed and can complete a limited human need even though it has no sovereignty over the outcome.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Possession of taught knowledge is affirmed immediately after the command's power to avail is denied, and it is contrasted with what most people do not know.
baseline_models.mechanism: The placement of repeated knowledge language after the efficacy limit separates epistemic guidance from causal mastery: taught discernment includes knowing how to act and where the act stops.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower supplies the explicit epistemic status of Jacob and its taught source.
A distinguishing mark that guides supplies the practical, orienting side of the knowledge.
Denied sufficiency prevents knowledge from being recast as guaranteed protection.
Numerical predominance supplies the many who miss the distinction between guidance and mastery.
The visible human collective supplies the social field in which the epistemic distinction is commonly lost.

changed_reading.before: A knowledgeable precaution should be vindicated by controlling or correctly predicting the result.
changed_reading.after: Taught knowledge can consist in calibrated action under an uncontrollable result; most people fail to distinguish guidance from mastery.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The only affirmed accomplishment is a need located in Jacob's self that he brought to completion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The exception relocates efficacy from the external field to the interior: outward compliance gives form and closure to an inward intention or pressure, possibly relieving it, without changing divine determination.

activation_trace.role: Dependence on something supplies the inward pressure that seeks enactment.
Intention and deliberation held within the self locate the command's immediate motive.
Relief that opens a constriction supplies the affective consequence of acting on the need.
Completion supplies closure rather than proof that the external danger was removed.

changed_reading.before: The need in Jacob's self is an unexplained private wish appended to the failed precaution.
changed_reading.after: The outward act completes and may release an inward pressure; that interior success coexists with external causal limitation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: They enter from an otherwise unspecified where fixed by the father's command, and the verse later names his taught knowledge.
baseline_models.mechanism: An obscure spatial field is made traversable by a command functioning as a route mark. Knowledge orients movement through uncertainty without promising what the movement will produce.

activation_trace.role: An indeterminate place supplies the spatial uncertainty to be oriented.
A sign or appointed marker supplies the exploratory image of the command as route guidance.
A distinguishing sign that guides supplies the navigational function of taught knowledge.
Actual passage inward turns the route mark into performed orientation.

changed_reading.before: The place from which they entered is incidental detail.
changed_reading.after: The prescribed where is a practical knowledge-mark for moving through an obscure field, valuable as orientation rather than as an outcome guarantee.

context_deltas.mechanism: The window brackets the focus with entries into fields of unequal recognition: Joseph recognizes the entrants before they recognize him, and after the commanded entry he privately gathers his brother. Jacob's taught orientation therefore does not make the travelers transparent to the hidden agents and relations through which the outcome unfolds.

activation_trace.role: Explicit knowing anchors the changed reading in the focus verse's epistemic contrast.
The earlier concrete entry supplies the first movement into a scene whose knowledge is unequal.
Recognition by a distinguishing trace supplies Joseph's informed side of the asymmetry.
The contrary of recognition supplies the brothers' simultaneous opacity.
Gathering someone into shelter supplies the concealed favorable event reached just after entry.
Brotherhood supplies the hidden relation disclosed inside the sheltering encounter.

structural_cues: The focus is bracketed by entry scenes at 12:58 and 12:69, with recognition asymmetry before it and private fraternal disclosure after it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated entry, one-sided recognition, and later sheltering; I infer that 12:68 marks guided movement through an epistemically unequal field; alternatively, its knowledge contrast may remain a general statement about Jacob alone.

changed_reading.before: Jacob knows a sound precaution while the undifferentiated majority simply lacks that practical insight.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge is distributed asymmetrically across a scene: Jacob can orient entry without revealing to the entrants who recognizes them or what protected relation the entry will uncover.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated full measures, food provision, increase, and ease create an economy of countable sufficiency around the journey. Against that field, the focus denies that any completed measure can convert material adequacy into security from God, while preserving the reality of Jacob's non-quantified inward need.

activation_trace.role: Sufficiency supplies the focus term whose scope is tested by the surrounding economy of measure.
Unmet need supplies the non-quantified interior remainder that material provision does not erase.
Fullness without deficiency supplies the promise of materially complete provision.
Measured food supplies the countable unit around which the brothers' access is organized.
Bringing food supplies the household provisioning goal pressed against Jacob's concern.
Numerical growth supplies the brothers' expectation of an added ration.
Repeated measuring makes quantified adequacy the scene's explicit practical currency.
Material amplitude or plenty supplies the claim that the additional measure is readily sufficient.

structural_cues: Measure recurs before the focus, and the brothers argue through provision, increase, and ease while Jacob answers through trust, covenant, and route.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a dense sequence of quantified food sufficiency; I infer that the focus's denied availing refuses conversion of measured provision into existential security; alternatively, the provisioning vocabulary may only explain the journey's occasion.

changed_reading.before: The denied availing is a generic statement that the route could not help.
changed_reading.after: In a narrative saturated with full and increased measures, no ration or logistical sufficiency can be exchanged for security; the only completed sufficiency named here is inward and limited.

context_deltas.mechanism: Jacob's comparison with an earlier failed entrustment loads the need in his self with memory. His turn from human trust to divine guarding and mercy makes the later route instruction a memory-shaped precaution coupled to relinquishment, not a claim that he can guard by technique.

activation_trace.role: Paternal care and formation supply the relational responsibility behind the inward need.
An intention held in the self supplies the focus location where remembered risk becomes a directive.
Settled trust supplies both the requested entrustment and the remembered breach against which it is judged.
Watchful guarding supplies the protective function Jacob relocates beyond the brothers and himself.
Tender mercy supplies the mode of divine care invoked after human guarding proves unreliable.

structural_cues: At 12:64 Jacob explicitly compares this entrustment with entrusting the other brother before, then names God the better guardian and the most merciful.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remembered entrustment, guarding, and mercy; I infer that prior loss causally loads the inward need expressed in 12:68; alternatively, the need may reflect sober fiduciary responsibility without an affective trauma model.

changed_reading.before: Jacob's inward need is an arbitrary personal preference that happens to be indulged.
changed_reading.after: The need is plausibly memory-shaped paternal risk management, enacted while guarding is consciously transferred beyond human technique.

context_deltas.mechanism: The covenant formalizes the brothers' controllable obligation, while the exception for total encirclement states a force-majeure boundary and the divine agent language transfers ultimate custody. This supplies a procedural analogue for the focus's distinction between completing a human requirement and being unable to avail against God.

activation_trace.role: Binding direction supplies the actionable human obligation whose limits are being calibrated.
Denied sufficiency supplies the boundary beyond which obligation cannot protect.
A confirmed covenant supplies the strongest humanly enforceable layer of the protocol.
Overwhelming enclosure supplies the explicit catastrophe under which the covenant ceases to govern performance.
One who stands over an affair with adequacy and preservation supplies the final custody beyond the pledge.

structural_cues: The pledge at 12:66 contains its own exception for total encirclement and ends by placing the spoken terms under God's agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covenant, explicit catastrophic exception, and divine agency; I infer a layered risk protocol whose enforceable domain ends at total loss; alternatively, the exception may be ordinary oath language rather than a general model of bounded means.

changed_reading.before: The focus adds a theological disclaimer after an otherwise protective tactic.
changed_reading.after: The sequence designs human obligation with an explicit failure boundary: covenant and command govern available action, while encirclement and outcome remain outside their sufficiency.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding instruction resolves the focus's unspecified route as entry through multiple separated gates rather than one gate. Spatial dispersion distributes exposure, while the repeated denial of availing, exclusive judgment, and reliance prevent that diversification from becoming a rival sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: The focus's indeterminate where supplies the slot that the preceding gate instruction resolves.
Deliberated counsel supplies the father's practical design rather than a bare command.
Repeated literal entry supplies the action distributed across alternative approaches.
Distinct entrances supply the spatial channels across which exposure is allocated.
Numerical oneness supplies the concentrated route explicitly rejected.
Separation into parts supplies the operational distribution of the group.
The directly repeated denial of sufficiency blocks dispersion from becoming guaranteed protection.
Decisive judgment supplies the authority reserved to God after the route is designed.
Reliant entrustment supplies the posture that accompanies, rather than cancels, distributed action.

structural_cues: At 12:67 the father opposes one gate to separated gates, immediately repeats that he cannot avail against God, reserves judgment to God, and repeats reliance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one-versus-separated entry channels and an explicit efficacy disclaimer; I infer that dispersion distributes a perceived exposure; alternatively, the route may manage crowd flow or another unspecified condition rather than protective risk.

changed_reading.before: They merely comply with an unspecified paternal route preference.
changed_reading.after: They enact a deliberate distribution of exposure across entrances, a knowledgeable hedge whose value is preserved precisely by refusing to treat it as sovereign protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later statement that Joseph could not take his brother under the king's regime except by divine willing gives a concrete legal analogue to the focus's could-not/except structure. Human arrangements neither secure the feared outcome nor prevent an unforeseen favorable one; divine planning works through and beyond institutional constraints.

activation_trace.role: Denied capacity to substitute for divine determination anchors the legal parallel in the focus.
The will related to a thing supplies the latent volitional side of the focus's all-encompassing negation.
Strategic contrivance supplies the hidden causal route attributed beyond Joseph's ordinary legal options.
Seizure or custody supplies the concrete desired outcome that the prevailing regime would not permit.
A regime of obedience supplies the institutional constraint under which taking the brother is impossible.
Explicit willing supplies the exception that opens a result unavailable under the human legal order.

structural_cues: Both 12:68 and 12:76 use a could-not construction followed by an exception tied to God, first around availing and later around taking the brother under the king's regime.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the syntactic echo, legal impossibility, divine strategy, and willing; I infer that the later episode concretizes the focus's causal limit in a favorable direction too; alternatively, the shared construction may be rhetorical without defining a symmetric model.

changed_reading.before: The non-availing clause only warns that Jacob's route cannot prevent a bad outcome.
changed_reading.after: Human means are limited in both directions: they cannot guarantee safety, but human law also cannot block a divinely opened favorable custody; the disclaimer is not merely pessimistic.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later knowledge language turns the focus's Jacob-versus-majority contrast into an open hierarchy. Jacob possesses taught discernment at this point, the brothers can be addressed as knowing within another episode, and raised degrees with a knower above every knower prevent any local knowledge from becoming absolute.

activation_trace.role: Taught disclosure supplies Jacob's real but derivative epistemic position.
The numerical majority supplies the immediate lower-knowledge comparison without exhausting the hierarchy.
Knowledge ascribed to the interlocutors supplies another local and contestable epistemic position.
Elevation in rank supplies the vertical organization of differing epistemic positions.
Movement degree by degree supplies a graded rather than binary knowledge structure.
Superiority of rank supplies the open upper relation above each possessor of knowledge.
The knower-above-knower formulation supplies the explicit refusal of epistemic finality.

structural_cues: The window moves from Jacob's taught knowledge and majority ignorance to contested human knowing at 12:73 and an explicitly vertical knowledge maxim at 12:76.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated knowing plus raised degrees and above-language; I infer an epistemic hierarchy in which Jacob's knowledge is genuine but non-final; alternatively, the closing maxim may generalize beyond the focus without ranking these specific actors.

changed_reading.before: Jacob's taught knowledge establishes a binary opposition in which he is the knower and everyone else is ignorant.
changed_reading.after: Jacob occupies a taught degree within layered knowledge: he exceeds the majority on this action while remaining inside an open hierarchy above every knower.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the inward need has the shape of an itinerary: a route held in the self becomes external movement without thereby controlling its destination.

surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verse pairs entry into a place with a need inside the self and then comments on hidden knowledge.

changed_reading.after: The focus can be carried as the first nested interior: an inward need travels through outward entry, anticipating hidden contents and plans that become legible only when extracted.

surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Jacob's taught knowledge accompanies an inward need but is explicitly denied the power to guarantee the external result.

activation_trace.role: Abundant water gathered in a reservoir supplies the image of taught knowledge as stored capacity.
Water that sustains the self supplies the reserve's limited function of maintaining action.
Giving drink supplies the contextual water activation later attached to the hidden object.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, taught knowledge is a held reserve that sustains calibrated action under uncertainty, while its vessel remains too bounded to contain or control the outcome.

strongest_changes: The immediate gate instruction turns an unspecified paternal preference into distributed spatial exposure while judgment and reliance keep that hedge non-sovereign.
The covenant and encirclement exception show human procedure designed with an explicit catastrophic boundary.
The later legal could-not/except construction makes non-availing symmetric: human means cannot guarantee safety, and human law cannot prevent a divinely opened favorable result.
The closing degree and above language revises Jacob's knowledge from absolute contrast into a real but derivative level in an open epistemic hierarchy.
summary.what_was_special: The focus preserves a three-way distinction that conservative synthesis can flatten: the command is knowledgeable, it genuinely completes an inward need, and it still does not control the outcome. Context activates this distinction through recognition asymmetry, measured provision, remembered entrustment, covenant, dispersed gates, hidden containers, legal constraint, and graded knowledge, while the split-root path and reservoir readings remain live but explicitly exploratory.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not specify which exposure the separated gates address, so distribution is strong while its exact risk target remains open.
The inward need can be carried simultaneously as rational procedure, paternal memory, and affective relief; the focus does not force one of these to displace the others.
The mapped path, nested-container, and knowledge-reservoir activations are coherent analogies but remain branch-distant and should not be promoted to lexical glosses.
The exact relation between taught knowledge and the practical success of the route remains intentionally non-identical to outcome control.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The tactic completes an inward need without becoming causal sovereignty.** ح و ج B001 (pressed need), ن ف س B013 (hidden intent), ق ض ي B004 (completion), and غ ن ي B002 distinguish psychological completion from outcome control. I infer that following the entry plan settles Jacob’s concern, even though it cannot independently avert decree.
2. **Taught knowledge includes knowing the limit of means.** ع ل م B001 is repeated around the explicit negation of efficacy. The ayah reads wisdom as both practical instruction and recognition that instruction does not guarantee results.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:83 echoed taught knowledge and judgment when Jacob hoped for complete gathering without claiming control of its route.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A practical need discharged without being made sovereign.** `ح و ج:B001` is “being pressed into need for something,” including seeking or being made to need; `ق ض ي:B004` is completion or discharge of a need. The sons enter as instructed, yet the ayah denies that the act controls divine outcome and limits its accomplishment to something in Jacob’s self; 12:69-73 then unfolds events no entry plan could settle. The packet supplies compliance, causal denial, and inner fulfillment; I infer that action can satisfy a finite prudential need without guaranteeing history. *Ḥājatan ... qaḍāhā* reads as bounded agency honestly named.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:76 identifies a divinely enabled stratagem that exceeds the family's precautions, confirming that prudential need can be satisfied without becoming sovereign over the event sequence.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الدخل بمعنى العيب والفساد والدغل والريبة والمكر والخديعة والعداوة المستبطنة، وما وصف بمدخول لخلل في العقل أو الأصل أو الجوف أو الطعام.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه التنفس والأنفاس وخروج الريح من الجوف أو الفم والمنخر، وما يلحق به من نفس الشرب إذا كان المراد به نفسا في الشرب.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sıkıntı içindeki kişinin yükünü hafifletme ve ona ferahlık sağlama eylemini açıkça kurar. Esinti ya da yardım da ancak bu rahatlatıcı işlev bakımından dala girer.

lexicalization_scope.note: Eylem kalıpları sıkıntıyı giderme işini, ayrı bir kullanım ise esinti ya da yardımı bu işin aracı olarak anlatır.

concept_map.definition: Sıkıntı içindeki birinin üzerindeki baskıyı azaltıp ona rahatlama sağlamaktır. Esinti ya da yardım, bu rahatlamayı sağladığı ölçüde aynı anlam alanına girer.

facets.statement: Sıkıntı içindeki kişinin yükünü hafifletip onu rahatlatma eylemidir.
Esinti veya yardım, sıkıntıdakine ferahlık getiren araç olarak adlandırılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, sıkıntının hafifletilmesi ile bunun sağladığı ferahlığı ortak çekirdek sayar; esinti ve yardım bu işlevle ilişkilendirilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin içinde bulunduğu darlık ya da ağır durum etkin biçimde azaltıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Önceki sıkıntıyı, yükün azaltılmasını ve ortaya çıkan rahatlamayı korur.

contextual_glosses.text: ferahlık getiren esinti ya da yardım
contextual_glosses.applicability: Esinti veya yardım, sıkıntıdaki kişiyi rahatlatan araç olarak anıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Aracın sıkıntıyı gideren işlevini açıkça korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: Tanrı'nın sıkıntıdakilere ferahlık getiren esintisi ya da yardımı

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, sıkıntıyı etkin biçimde hafifleten kişi, güç ya da aracı öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, üzüntü ve kaygının çözülüp ortadan kalkması sonucunu daha geniş biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da darlık ve üzüntüden rahatlığa geçişi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak, bir sıkıntıyı giderip kişiye ferahlık verme eylemidir; komşu, bu etkinin sonucu olan çözülme ve kurtulma durumuna daha çok ağırlık verir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; sıkıntının giderilmesiyle doğan rahatlama sınırını en iyi açıklayan yakın anlamlı komşu yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه نفس الله الكربة، والتنفس عن المكروب، والفرج من الشدة، والريح أو الأنصار حين تذكر باعتبار التفريج.
branches.source_phrase_ar: نفس الله كربته والنفس كل شيء يفرج به عن مكروب (maqayis); نفست عنه تنفيسا أي رفهت (sihah); اللهم نفس عني أي فرج عني والريح من نفس الرحمن (tahdhib;mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تسمية العين نفسا، وإصابة المنظور بنفس، والنافس بمعنى العائن.
يدخل فيه النفس بمعنى الدم، والنفس السائلة، وتسميته نفسا لأن فقد الدم يذهب بالنفس.
يدخل فيه النفاس ولادة المرأة، والنفساء، والمنفوس بمعنى المولود، واستعماله في الحيض حيث نص المصدر عليه.
يدخل فيه الشرب بنفس أو أنفاس، والنفس بمعنى الجرعة أو المستراح في الشرب.
يدخل فيه النفس أو النفسين من الدباغ، أي مقدار يسير يدبغ به الجلد مرة أو مرتين.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi suyu yaşamı ayakta tutan madde olarak adlandırır ve içeceğin bol, doyurucu ve susuzluğu giderici oluşunu aynı bağıntıyla açıklar. Karşıt kalıp bu niteliğin bulunmadığını bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçim suyu, iki karşıt kalıp ise içecekte doyurucu genişliğin bulunmasını ya da bulunmamasını anlatır.

concept_map.definition: Yaşamı ayakta tutan su ve içene genişlik sağlayıp susuzluğu gideren doyurucu içecektir. Karşıt kullanım, içeceğin bu rahat içimli ve doyurucu niteliği taşımadığını belirtir.

facets.statement: Su, yaşamın sürmesini sağlayan temel içecek olarak adlandırılır.
İçecek, bol ve susuzluğu giderici olduğunda doyurucu bir genişlik taşır.
Karşıt kalıp, içecekte doyurucu ve rahat içimli niteliğin bulunmadığını bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar suyu yaşamın dayanağı sayar; içecekte bolluk ve susuzluğu giderme niteliğini olumlu ve olumsuz kalıplarla karşılaştırır.

concept_gloss.text: yaşamı sürdüren, bol ve doyurucu su
concept_gloss.applicability: Su ya da içecek, yaşamı destekleyen ve susuzluğu gideren yeterlilik bakımından anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yaşamı sürdürme, bolluk ve susuzluğu giderme özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İçeceğin karşıt kalıpla, rahat içim ve doyuruculuktan yoksun olduğu anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Doyurucu ve rahat içimli niteliğin yokluğunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: tadı kötü, bayat ve içimi güç içecek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal suyu ve içeceği, doyurucu niteliğin taşıyıcısı olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal susuzluğu giderme eylemini ve haber ya da görüşle iç rahatlığı bulma uzantısını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da su içmenin susuzluğu giderip rahatlık sağlaması alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak, suyun ya da içeceğin yeterli ve doyurucu niteliğidir; komşu ise içenin susuzluktan kurtulması sonucunu ve bunun mecazlı uzantısını anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar karşılaştırıldı; susuzluğu giderme komşusu, içeceğin niteliği ile içenin ulaştığı sonuç arasındaki sınırı belirginleştirir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تسمية الماء نفسا، والشراب ذو النفس إذا كان فيه سعة وري، ونقيضه الشراب غير ذي نفس.
branches.source_phrase_ar: يقال للماء نفس ولأن قوام النفس به (maqayis); النفس الماء وشراب ذو نفس أي فيه سعة وري وشراب غير ذي نفس (tahdhib)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تنفس الصبح والنهار إذا تبلج أو امتد، وتنفس القوس إذا انشقت، وزيادة الماء أو الموج حين يخرجان أو ينتشران.
يدخل فيه النفيس والنفاسة والمنفس، والرغبة والمنافسة في الشيء، والضن أو الحسد به إذا كان لقيمته ورغبة النفس فيه.
يدخل فيه النفس بمعنى الروح والحياة، وكل إنسان نفس، وخروج النفس عند الموت، والنفس الحية التي بها حياة الجسد.
يدخل فيه النفس بمعنى عين الشيء، ذاته، حقيقته، جملته، كنهه وجوهره، واستعمالها للتوكيد.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişinin içinde taşıdığı düşünceyi, niyeti ve bilgiyi; ayrıca ayırt etmeyi sağlayan zihinsel yetiyi açıkça aynı içsel idrak alanında toplar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kalıp kullanım içteki düşünce ve niyeti, ayrı birim ise ayırt etmeyi sağlayan zihinsel gücü anlatır.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin içinde bulunan, henüz dışa vurulmamış düşünce, niyet veya bilgidir. Aynı alan, kişinin ayırt etmesini sağlayan zihinsel gücü de kapsar.

facets.statement: Kişinin içinde tuttuğu düşünce, niyet ya da kendine özgü bilgidir.
Doğru ayrımlar yapmayı sağlayan zihinsel yeti de bu içsel idrak alanında adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kişinin içindeki düşünce ve bilgiyi ayırt etme yetisiyle birlikte içsel idrak alanında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: iç düşünce, niyet ve ayırt etme gücü
concept_gloss.applicability: Kişinin dışa vurmadığı içeriği veya ayrım yapmasını sağlayan zihinsel yetisi anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İç düşünceyi, niyeti, bilgiyi ve ayırt etme yetisini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin henüz söylemediği bir şeyi düşünmesi ya da yapmaya niyetlenmesi bağlamında doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Düşüncenin içte bulunmasını ve henüz dışa vurulmamasını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: onun içinden geçen düşünce ya da niyet

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, dışa vurulmamış düşüncenin yanında niyet, iç bilgi ve ayırt etme yetisini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, sözle ortaya konmadan önce zihinde tasarlanan söyleyiş içeriğine odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin zihninde bulunan fakat henüz sözle açıklanmamış içeriği kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal içsel idrakin daha geniş alanıdır; komşu dal özellikle dile getirilmeden önce zihinde tasarlanan söze yönelir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; söylenmemiş düşünce komşusu, içsel alanın söz tasarısından daha geniş olduğunu en açık biçimde gösterir.
branches.branch_image_ar: ما في النفس من عقل وروع
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ما في نفس المرء من روع وقصد، ونفس العقل والتمييز، وما يعبر عنه بالغيب أو العندية في سياق ما في النفس.
branches.source_phrase_ar: نفس العقل التي يكون بها التمييز وفي نفس فلان أن يفعل أي في روعه وتعلم ما في نفسي أي ما عندي أو غيبك (tahdhib); يعلم ما في أنفسكم وتعلم ما في نفسي ولا أعلم ما في نفسك (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النفس بمعنى الخلق والجلادة والسخاء، وبمعنى العظمة والكبر والعزة والهمة والأنفة.
يدخل فيه السعة في الأمر، والفسحة، والمهلة، وطول الأجل أو النهار أو الكتاب، وبعد المنزل واتساع ما بين الفريقين.
يدخل فيه النافس اسما لقدح من قداح الميسر، خاصة الخامس على نص أكثر المصادر، مع التنبيه إلى قول الرابع في Sihah.

root_profile.summary: Kök, soluk alıp vermeden sıkıntı giderme, kan, doğum, içim payı, su, açılma-genişleme, değer yarışı, canlılık, özdeşlik, iç düşünce, karakter ve eski oyun okuna uzanan çok dallı bir anlam ağı kurar. Dalların bir bölümü soluk ve yaşam çevresinde gevşekçe bağlanırken bir bölümü kalıba bağlı uzmanlaşmış adlandırmalardır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الحكم بين الخصوم، والقضاء بمعنى الأمر والحتم وفصل الحكم
يدخل فيه قضى إليه عهدا، والإعلام والإيحاء والإنهاء والإبلاغ إلى المخاطب
يدخل فيه قضى عليه الموت، وقضى نحبه بمعنى مات، والقتل، والقاضية والمنية، والمنايا المنفذة

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir gereksinimi, ibadeti, süreyi veya başka bir işi tamamlayıp bitirme ile bir şeyin geçip gitmesi, tükenmesi ve yok olması aşamalarını açıkça destekler. Geçici çerçeve, tamamlanan eylem ile sona eren şey arasındaki katılımcı farkını koruduğu sürece uygundur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, sona erme bildiren biçim ile belirli iş, gereksinim, ibadet ve süre söz öbeklerini ayırır; bu kalıpların bütün ayrıntıları çıplak biçime yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi, gereksinimi, ibadeti veya süreyi son sınırına ulaştırıp tamamlamak; ya da bir şeyin süresi dolarak geçip gitmesi, tükenmesi ve ortadan kalkmasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir işi veya süreci gereken son sınıra ulaştırarak tamamlayıp bitirme.
Bir şeyin süresi veya varlığı sona ererek geçip gitmesi ve tükenmesi.
Bir işin artık geri alınamayacak biçimde kesin olarak sonuçlanması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir işi bitirip ondan çıkma ile bir şeyin süresinin veya varlığının tükenip gitmesini aynı sona ulaşma çevresinde birleştirir; bazı kullanımlarda sonuç geri alınamaz duruma gelir.

concept_gloss.text: tamamlayıp bitirmek veya sona erip tükenmek
concept_gloss.applicability: Etkenin bir işi bitirmesi ile bir şeyin kendiliğinden sona erip ortadan kalkması arasındaki ayrımı koruyarak dalın bütün çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Tamamlama, son sınıra ulaşma, tükenme ve ortadan kalkma yönlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gereksinim, ibadet, yükümlülük veya süre gibi bir işin sonuna ulaştırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Etkenin bir işi son sınırına ulaştırıp bitirmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir şeyin kendiliğinden tükenip ortadan kalkması yönünü dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin süresi veya varlığı biterek geçip gittiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sona erme, geçip gitme ve tükenme yönlerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir etkenin işi bilinçli olarak tamamlayıp bitirmesini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işin geri alınamayacak veya düzeltilemeyecek biçimde tamamlandığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sonucun kesinleşmesi ve geri alınamaz duruma gelmesi yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel tamamlama ile tükenip yok olma kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyin tükenip geçmesi ve ortadan kalkması sonucunu da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Eksik olanı tamamlayan parça ve bir topluluğun sayıca tamamlanması gibi kullanımları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir işin veya şeyin gereken son sınıra ulaşmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal eksiksiz ve tam duruma gelmeyi öne çıkarır; odak dal buna ek olarak işten çıkmayı, sürenin dolmasını ve varlığın tükenmesini içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir gereksinimi, ibadeti veya işi etken olarak tamamlayıp bitirmeyi içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yol, vadi ve kumluk gibi uzamsal şeylerin uç veya bitim noktasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyin devamının kesilerek son sınıra ulaşmasını karşılar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hem etkenli tamamlama hem tükenip gitme sürecidir; komşu dal daha genel kesilme, zamanın bitmesi ve uzamsal son nokta çevresindedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Canlılık şartı olmadan iş, süre, gereksinim veya nesnenin tamamlanmasını ve tükenmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yaşamın ölümle sona ermesini ve bir canlının öldürülmesini gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir sürecin artık sürmediği kesin bir son vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel tamamlanma ve tükenmedir; komşu dalın kurucu sonucu yalnızca yaşamın sona ermesidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; tamlığa ulaşma, kesilip sona erme ve ölümle bitiş en yararlı sınırları gösterdi, son parça veya dökme gibi daha uzak adaylar yayımlanmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الفراغ من الحاجة والعبادة والمناسك، تمام الأمر، انقضاء الشيء وفناؤه، وقضاء الأجل والوطر والعبرة

root_profile.summary: Kök, bir işi kesin karara bağlama çekirdeğinden kesin bildirim, ölümle sonlanma, tamamlanıp tükenme, kusursuzca yapıp yürürlüğe koyma ve borç ilişkisini kapatma dallarına yayılır. Bunun yanında uzun süre bırakılan tulumun bozulması ile kuru üzüm çekirdeği ve onu yeme anlamları ayrı sözlüksel dallar oluşturur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın bilme ve bilgisizliğin karşıtı olma yönündeki çekirdeği kaynak ifadesiyle uyumludur. Ancak haberden haberdar olma, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme kullanımları bu çekirdekle aynı düzeyde değil, belirli biçimlere bağlı uzantılar olarak tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak bilme çekirdeğini öne alır; haber, öğretim, öğrenim ve karşılıklı bilgi sınamasıyla ilgili anlamları yalnızca ilgili biçim ve kuruluşlara bağlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bilmek, tanımak ve onu gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavramak; böylece bilgisizlikten çıkmaktır. Haber verilmesi, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme bu çekirdekten hareket eden, belirli biçimlere bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
Bir haberin farkına varmak veya ondan haberdar olmak, bilme çekirdeğinin belirli bir konuya uygulanmasıdır.
Bildirme, öğretme ve öğrenme biçimleri bilginin bir başkasına ulaştırılması ya da kişinin onu edinmesi süreçlerini anlatır.
Karşılıklı bilgi sınamasında birini yenmek, belirli bir kuruluşta ortaya çıkan rekabetçi kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, bilgiyi bilgisizliğin karşıtı sayar ve bir şeyi tanıyıp gerçeğiyle kavramayı öne çıkarır. Toplu tanıklık ayrıca haberden haberdar olmayı, bilgiyi aktarmayı, öğrenmeyi ve bilgiyle üstün gelmeyi biçime bağlı uzantılar olarak gösterir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bilginin tekrar ve yönlendirmeyle bir öğrenende yerleşmesini sağlayan öğretim bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bilginin aktarılması ve öğrenende kalıcı bir sonuç oluşturması sürecini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi başkasından ayıran belirgin izi dalın ortak çekirdeği olarak açıkça destekler. Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş deseni ve savaş işareti gibi örnekler bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir; tanınmış kişi ve son zaman belirtisi ise benzetme veya gösterme ilişkisine bağlı uzantılardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ayırt edici iz çıplak çekirdektir; savaşçı, kumaş, sarık ve belirli zaman göstergesiyle kurulan anlamlar kendi kuruluşlarına bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başkalarından ayıran, tanınmasını sağlayan veya ona götüren belirgin iz ya da işarettir. Bayrak, uzaktan seçilen dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş kenarı ve sonradan konan tanıtıcı izler bu işlevin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi veya kişiyi başkalarından ayırıp tanınır kılan belirgin iz ya da işaret çekirdeği oluşturur.
Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi ve kumaşın kenar deseni yön bulduran veya tanıtan somut gerçekleşmelerdir.
Savaşçının, kumaşın veya sarığın ayırt edici bir işaretle donatılması belirli kuruluşlara bağlı eylemsel kullanımdır.
Tanınmış bir kişinin belirgin bir bayrağa benzetilmesi ve yaklaşan son zamanı gösteren belirti, işaret çekirdeğinin uzantılarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ayırt edici izi ortak temel sayar ve bayrak, yüksek ya da belirgin dağ, yol göstergesi, kumaş kenarı, kına ve sonradan yerleştirilen tanıtıcı işaretleri bu temelde toplar. Tanınmış kişi ile yaklaşan son zamanın belirtisi de görünürlük ve gösterme işlevinden doğan uzantılardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir su birikimi türü tanımlamaz; aynı sözlük biçimi için deniz ve suyu bol kuyu olmak üzere iki ayrı karşılık verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak geçici çerçevedeki ortak su kütlesi görüntüsü yerine bu açık seçeneklilik tanıma yazılmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak sözlük biçiminin deniz ve suyu bol kuyu karşılıklarını ayrı ayrı korur; bunlardan genel bir su birikintisi anlamı türetmez.

concept_map.definition: Aynı sözlük biçiminin bir kullanımda denizi, başka bir kullanımda ise suyu bol kuyuyu adlandırmasıdır. İki karşılık, genel bir su birikintisi anlamında kaynaştırılmaz.

facets.statement: Dal, aynı adın iki ayrı su varlığına verilen sözlük karşılıklarını birlikte kaydeder.
Bir kaynak karşılığında ad, geniş tuzlu su kütlesi olan denizi gösterir.
Diğer ve daha yaygın kaynak karşılığında ad, suyu çok olan kuyuyu gösterir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه كثرة الشيء والعدد والمال، وضد القلة، والوصف بكثير وكثار وكاثر، وجعل الشيء كثيرا أو الاستكثار منه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكثرة نماء العدد (ayn;tahdhib)؛ الكثير ضد القليل (jamhara)؛ الكثرة نقيض القلة (sihah)؛ أصل صحيح يدل خلاف القلة (maqayis)؛ الكثرة والقلة يستعملان في الكمية المنفصلة كالأعداد (mufradat)؛ كثر الشيء كثرة فهو كثير (ayn;sihah;tahdhib)؛ أكثرت الشيء وكثرته جعلته كثيرا (ayn;tahdhib)؛ استكثرت من الشيء أي أكثرت منه (sihah)؛ عدد كثار وكثير وكاثر (jamhara;sihah;mufradat;maqayis)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه كاثرناهم فكثرناهم، ومكاثرة القوم إذا غلبوا غيرهم بالعدد، والتكاثر والتفاخر أو التباري بكثرة العدد والمال والعز.

concept_gloss.text: çokluk yarışı ve çoklukla üstün gelme

branches.branch_image_ar: كثرة في صاحب أو كلام أو مطالب
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه مكثر أو كاثر بمعنى كثير المال، ومكثار في كثرة الكلام، ومكثور عليه لكثرة طالبي المعروف أو الحقوق عليه، ويتكثر بمال غيره.
يدخل فيه الكوثر بوصفه نهر الجنة، أو الخير الكثير العظيم، أو الرجل السيد السخي الكثير الخير والعطاء، وكل ذلك من فوعل الكثرة.
يدخل فيه الكوثر من الغبار إذا كثر وثار أو سطع، وتكوثر الشيء إذا كثر كثرة متناهية.
يدخل فيه الكثر أو الكثر بمعنى جمار النخل، والجذب، وطلع النخل عند بعض المصادر، وما ورد في لا قطع في ثمر ولا كثر.
يدخل فيه الكمثرة بمعنى اجتماع الشيء، مع تصريح Maqāyīs بأن الميم زائدة وأنه من الكثرة.

root_profile.summary: Kökün ana alanı azlığın karşıtı olan çokluk ve sayıca artmadır; buradan çokluk yarışı, kişiye bağlı kalıplar ve aşırı bolluk kullanımları gelişir. Ayrıca özel ırmak ve bol iyilik, yoğun toz, hurma ağacının iç göbeği ve bir araya toplanma gibi sözlükselleşmiş ayrı dallar bulunur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısındaki insan türünü, bu türün topluluğunu ve tek bir üyesini birlikte gösterir. Görünür olma açıklaması adlandırma gerekçesidir; insan olmanın kurucu tanımı değildir. Evde kimsenin bulunmadığını bildiren kalıp ise dal çekirdeğine genellenemez ve yalnızca kendi sözcüksel biriminde korunmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçimlerdeki insan ve insan topluluğu anlamı dal çekirdeğidir; evde hiç kimse bulunmadığını anlatan kalıp ayrı tutulur ve çekirdeğe yeni bir genel anlam katmaz.

concept_map.definition: Görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısında yer alan insan türünü, bu türün topluluğunu ya da tek bir üyesini belirtir. İnsanların görünür oluşu, bu adlandırma için aktarılan bir gerekçedir.

facets.statement: İnsan türünü, insanların oluşturduğu topluluğu veya bu türün tek bir üyesini görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısında adlandırır.
Adlandırmanın insanların duyularla görünür oluşuna bağlanması, anlamın özü değil kökene ilişkin bir açıklamadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, dalın insan türünü hem topluluk hem tek kişi olarak gösterebildiğinde ve görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfıyla karşıtlık kurduğunda birleşir. Görünürlük, ortak anlamdan çok adlandırmanın gerekçesi olarak sunulur.

concept_gloss.text: insan türü ve bu türden bir kişi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, insanları görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısında bir tür olarak kurar ve görünürlüğe dayalı bir adlandırma açıklaması taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, insanı görünür ten ve yaratılmış beden yönüyle adlandırır; tekil, çoğul, erkek ve kadın kapsamını özellikle öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: insan türünü iki ayrı yönden adlandırma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da insanı hem tür hem bu türün üyesi olarak gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Yer değiştirme yalnız insanı genel olarak adlandıran bağlamlarda mümkündür. Odak dalın görünmeyen varlıklarla sınıf karşıtlığı, komşunun ise görünür beden yönü kendi sınırında kalır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yalnız insan türünü ve bu türün tekil ya da toplu üyelerini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yeryüzündeki bütün yaratılmışları kapsayabilir ve bazı yorumlarda insanlarla görünmeyen varlıkları birlikte içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İnsanlar iki dalın gönderim alanında da bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşunun genel yaratılmışlar kapsamı odak dala taşınamaz; odak dal da yalnız insanları belirttiği için bütün yaratılmışların yerine kullanılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal insan türünü ve bu türün üyelerini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yabancılık ve ürkme duygusunun kalkmasını, yakınlık ve rahatlık oluşmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: insan adı ile yakınlık duygusu ayrımı

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Birinde insanın kim olduğu adlandırılır, diğerinde bir kişi ya da şey karşısındaki duygusal durum anlatılır; sıradan bağlamlarda birbirlerinin yerine geçmezler.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإنس والبشر والناس والأناسي والإنسان من حيث الجماعة أو الواحد، وما بالدار أنيس بمعنى أحد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الإنس خلاف الجن وسموا لظهورهم (maqayis;mufradat)؛ الإنس البشر والواحد إنسي والجمع أناسي (sihah)؛ الإنس جماعة الناس والأناسي جماع (tahdhib)

branches.branch_image_ar: إيناس الشيء برؤية أو إحساس أو سماع
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آنس الشيء إذا أبصره أو رآه، وآنس الصوت إذا سمعه، وأحس الفزع أو وجد الشيء في نفسه، والاستئناس بمعنى النظر والتبصر.
يدخل فيه أنس الإنسان بالشيء أو بفلان، المؤانسة والتأنيس، الأنيس وكل ما يؤنس به، الفرح بالقرب والحديث، والحيوان الأنوس غير العقور.
يدخل فيه إنسي الدابة والقوس وكل شيئين: ما يلي الإنسان أو يقبل على الراكب أو الرامي، في مقابلة الوحشي.

branches.branch_image_ar: إنسان العين وصورة الإنسان في السواد
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إنسان العين: المثال أو الصبي الذي يرى في سواد العين، وما ألحقه تهذيب اللغة من الأنملة أو إنسان الكف.
يدخل فيه كيف ابن إنسك للسؤال عن النفس، وفلان ابن أنس فلان لصفيه وخاصته، وما قاربه من الخدن والأنيس والخلص والجليس.
يدخل فيه تفسير حتى تستأنسوا بالاستئذان أو السلام وطلب الدخول، أو بإيجاد إيناس قبل الدخول.

root_profile.summary: Kök, insan türünü adlandırma, duyularla fark etme ve yabancılığın kalkıp yakınlık oluşması çevresinde birkaç bağlı anlam geliştirir. Ayrıca insana dönük yan, gözde görülen küçük görüntü, kişinin kendisi veya seçilmiş yakını ve eve girişten önce kabul arama gibi belirgin biçimde ayrılmış kullanımları vardır.
